<reason>PRO won the central incentive clash. CON argued stronger access causes earlier concealment and asymmetric enforcement, but PRO showed you cannot make a spreading pathogen vanish, only confirmation can be suppressed, and a universal pre-agreed right with refusal-as-signal makes delay costlier than opening. CON never solved carrots-without-verification blindness or why ad hoc power politics is better than a standing rule.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>PRO's rumor vs confirmation distinction plus refusal-starts-the-clock turn in B2/B4, which neutralized CON's earlier-concealment and honest-hesitation-equals-guilt attacks and made inviting experts the cheaper option.</best_rebuttal>
